rename.nameHint: Leave it empty to show the realm's short id.
rename.colorHint: Colour is kept on this device.
rename.notYet: Not applied yet: the old name still shows. The rename may still go through; check again in a moment, or stop tracking it.
rename.left: Stopped tracking. The rename may still go through; the realm names will show it if it does.
rename.elsewhere: It was renamed somewhere else meanwhile and is now called {{name}}.
rename.reserved: “{{word}}” is a word the Hub uses. Pick another name.
rename.length: Names can be up to 64 characters.
rename.control: Names can't contain hidden or control characters.
rename.taken: Another realm is already called that.
rename.failed: Couldn't rename the realm. Its name wasn't changed.
rename.notSent: The rename wasn't sent. Its name wasn't changed.
rename.unsafe: The realm names could not be read safely, so the rename wasn't sent. Try again.
top.realmHintMore: Realms in use. You can upgrade if you want more realms.
palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command or a page…
chrome.announceOn: Focus mode on. Esc or the button at the bottom right brings the menus back.
cr.none.title: No computer selected
cr.none.body: Pick a computer in the top bar.
cr.stopped.title: This computer is stopped
cr.stopped.body: Start it from Computers, then come back here.
cr.stopped.bodyNoLink: Start it, then come back here.
cr.empty.title: No computers yet
cr.empty.body: Everything on this page runs on one of your computers, and this account has none yet.
cr.empty.bodyCannot: Everything on this page runs on one of your computers. This sign-in can't create one: sign in to your account to get one.
cr.emptyRealm.title: No computers in this realm
cr.emptyRealm.body: Show all realms to see every computer on this account, or to get one.
cr.emptyRealm.bodyPinned: This sign-in reaches this realm only.
cr.list.failedBody: The Hub couldn't read your list of computers, so it can't tell whether one is picked.
leave.title: Work is still running from this tab
leave.body_one: {{count}} upload or change is still running from this tab. If you go on, it stops, and it may have gone through. Check it again afterwards.
leave.body_other: {{count}} uploads or changes are still running from this tab. If you go on, they stop, and each may have gone through. Check them again afterwards.
signout.title: Sign out with unconfirmed changes?
signout.body_one: {{count}} change may have gone through, and the Hub has not confirmed it yet.
signout.body_other: {{count}} changes may have gone through, and the Hub has not confirmed them yet.
signout.forgetAll_one: If you sign out, this browser stops tracking it and can no longer check it for you.
signout.forgetAll_other: If you sign out, this browser stops tracking them and can no longer check them for you.
signout.forgetSome_one: If you sign out, this browser stops tracking {{count}} of them and can no longer check that one for you.
signout.forgetSome_other: If you sign out, this browser stops tracking {{count}} of them and can no longer check those for you.
signout.savingTitle: Sign out with an unsaved change?
signout.stillSaving: A setting isn't saved on this browser yet. If you sign out now, it's lost.
signout.plainBody: Everything on this browser is confirmed and saved now.
signout.forgetFailed: This browser couldn't stop tracking these changes, so you're still signed in. Try again.
signout.sending_one: {{count}} change is still being sent. Signing out doesn't stop it: it stays on this browser and keeps the same change blocked until its answer comes back.
signout.sending_other: {{count}} changes are still being sent. Signing out doesn't stop them: they stay on this browser and keep the same change blocked until their answers come back.
signout.changed: Something changed on this browser while you were deciding, so you're still signed in. Read the warning again, then sign out.
signout.unknown: This browser may already have stopped tracking those changes, but sign-out didn't finish, so you're still signed in. Sign out again to finish.
signout.failed: Sign-out didn't finish on this browser, so you're still signed in. Try again.
signout.asksTitle: Sign out while the assistant may still answer?
signout.asks_one: {{count}} question to the assistant may still be answered. If you sign out, this browser stops waiting for it, and its answer won't show here.
signout.asks_other: {{count}} questions to the assistant may still be answered. If you sign out, this browser stops waiting for them, and their answers won't show here.
signout.mayForgot: This browser may already have stopped tracking changes you confirmed, so it can no longer check them for you.
signout.asksStopped: This browser no longer keeps track of the questions you confirmed to the assistant, so an answer may not show here.
signout.unknownPlain: Sign-out didn't finish, so you're still signed in. This browser may already have cleared part of what it was keeping. Sign out again to finish.

ask.label: Agent

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.hideList: Hide or show the list beside a detail
otp.title: Enter your two-step code
otp.body: This change needs the code from your authenticator app.
otp.label: Code
otp.help: Use the newest code your app shows. A backup code doesn't work here.
otp.help.term: Use the newest code your app shows. A backup code is not accepted here.
otp.wrong: That code didn't work or was already used. Wait for the next code.
hint.inbox: New notices appear here and on the bell.
hint.bell: Notices about your computers, rentals and account appear here.
hint.computer: A new computer sends a notice when it is running, or if it fails.
hint.purchase: You get a notice when a server order is ready, or if it runs late.
hint.rental: You get a notice before a server rental ends.
hint.bot: Waiting on a Bot? A browser alert can tell you when it needs you, while the Hub is open in another tab.
hint.script: Running something long? A browser alert can tell you when it finishes, while the Hub is open in another tab.
hint.schedule: A browser alert can tell you when a schedule fails, while the Hub is open in another tab.
hint.alertsToo: You can add a browser alert.
alert.botTitle: A Bot is waiting for you
alert.body: Open the Hub to read it.
notice.realmGone: The realm you were using is no longer available
notice.realmGoneBody: The Hub shows all your realms now. Pick one from the realm menu to work in it.
notice.realmNotRestored: Couldn't reopen the realm you last used
notice.realmNotRestoredBody: The Hub couldn't confirm it when it opened, so it shows all your realms.
realmParam.unknown: Couldn't open realm {{realm}} from this link
notice.pending: A change in {{realm}} may have gone through
notice.pendingBody: The answer didn't arrive. Check there before you try it again.
notice.tokenEnding: This shared access ends in {{minutes}} min.
notice.tokenChanged: This shared access changed. The Hub now shows what it allows.
notice.offline: You're offline. The Hub shows what it last loaded.
notice.network: The Hub can't reach the server right now.
notice.hubUpdated: Hub was updated. Reload to continue.
notice.chunkFailed: Part of the Hub couldn't load. Check your connection, then reload.
notice.suspendedBody: Your computers and Bots are paused while the account is suspended. Check your notifications for the reason and what to do next.
notice.purgeBody: The Hub couldn't clear your data from this browser. Try again, or close this tab and clear the site's data.
notice.sendsKept_one: {{count}} change was still being sent: it stays on this browser and keeps the same change blocked until its answer comes back.
notice.sendsKept_other: {{count}} changes were still being sent: they stay on this browser and keep the same change blocked until their answers come back.
lock.screen.title: Hoody Hub is locked
lock.screen.body: Enter your passcode to go on.
lock.screen.wrongLeft_one: Wrong passcode. {{count}} try left before this browser signs out.
lock.screen.wrongLeft_other: Wrong passcode. {{count}} tries left before this browser signs out.
lock.screen.check: Couldn't check the passcode. Try again.
lock.screen.noVerifier: This lock can't be opened on this browser. Forget this browser to remove it, then sign in again.
lock.forgot.title: Forget this browser?
lock.forgot.body: This signs you out here and removes the passcode and other saved Hub data on this browser. You'll need to sign in again.
lock.removedElsewhere: The passcode was turned off in another window. Reload to continue.
lock.noWebLocks: This browser can't check your passcode safely. Forget this browser to continue.
